items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The people that started to do that — Eddie Jefferson, Jon Hendricks, Annie Ross — they had great solos to choose from.

ctx.x: So for those people on YouTube, my name is Monk Rowe and this is Giacomo Gates, and we just saw you perform last night. I took copious notes, so I hope you’ll analyze your own performance with great elan. It occurred to me maybe during the second or third song when you were doing vocalese, how magnificent those solos were that you and the vocalese masters set words to, that one of the ways to appreciate those solos is to listen to them with vocalese, because they are just musical gems.

I agree. I agree. The people that started to do that — Eddie Jefferson, Jon Hendricks, Annie Ross — they had great solos to choose from. People played lyrical stories, melodic lyrical stories. I’m not saying it’s easy to put lyrics to that, but the solos are just amazing. Amazing.
